Our process

From boat to finished deck.

A straightforward process keeps the project accurate and gives you a chance to approve the design before material is cut.

STEP 01
Boat Info

Tell us the year, make, model, areas to cover, and your design ideas.

STEP 02
Digital Template

We capture the exact shape and dimensions of the areas being covered.

STEP 03
CAD Design

Your deck is laid out digitally with patterns, borders, logos, and details.

STEP 04
CNC Cut

Approved designs are precisely machined from your selected EVA material.

STEP 05
Installation

The surface is prepared and your finished decking is professionally installed.
